releases.label: 2026.08.19 · Visual Writer & Avery
releases.title: Foundations and World now form a complete guided visual-writing loop
releases.summary: PlotPickle now carries a writer from learning through story decisions into a reviewable visual wireframe, then lets Avery independently exercise and preserve that same current journey for owner review.
added: World now follows the same LEARN → PLAN → BUILD journey as Foundations.
Avery keeps a read-only local history with exactly four recent Dashboard session positions and full older-session review.
Avery session cards can surface session-owned visuals plus POSTER and TRAILER review when those artifacts exist.
changed: The Dashboard now explains the current Visual Writer frontier, accepted and draft artifact state, and the next available action.
Foundations and World BUILD preserve visual history and provenance instead of treating every generation as accepted canon.
PlotPickle helpers now share one 8-bit lorebound visual identity.

releases.label: 2026.08.19 · Local AI & Settings
releases.title: Local image setup is clearer and no longer blocks PlotPickle startup
releases.summary: Local ComfyUI remains optional and local-first, while AI setup now takes writers directly to the correct provider controls and reports real readiness more clearly.
added: OpenAI and MiniMax now have direct in-place setup surfaces alongside Ollama and ComfyUI.
Hybrid Ollama + ComfyUI routing exposes both setup destinations instead of hiding one owner.
changed: Optional companion maintenance now happens after the core PlotPickle server is reachable.
ComfyUI readiness distinguishes running service, model readiness, test-needed state and active routing.
Community NODE display now reflects the real connected BUZZ node rather than a presentation alias.
fixed: PlotPickle startup no longer waits for an optional interactive ComfyUI Desktop launch.
AI Routing setup buttons no longer bounce back to the Settings landing page.
Settings AI Routing and ComfyUI surfaces use the current PlotPickle dark visual system consistently.

releases.label: 2026.08.18 · Local Creative Foundation
releases.title: Local rendering, hardware awareness and verification became first-class product capabilities
releases.summary: PlotPickle strengthened its local creative stack with reviewed image-model setup, optional local animatic rendering, hardware-aware model choices and safer long-running verification.
added: A reviewed SDXL starter flow can prepare local ComfyUI image generation without silently downloading unrelated model packs.
BUILD can optionally prepare, validate, preview and render a local Lazy Frames animatic.
Hardware-aware model preferences help choose local models for speed, quality or lower memory use.
The Community BBS provides a keyboard-friendly BUZZ-backed front door for rooms, people, agents and reviews.
changed: Full Verification now uses bounded graph execution and visible progress while deterministic stages remain authoritative.
PlotPickle Node defines a local-first foundation for future split or remote compute without making the desktop app public by default.
fixed: Windows verification gained watchdogs and bounded cleanup so a stalled child process cannot silently hang the whole run.
Managed ComfyUI readiness better distinguishes installed, stopped, provisioning and ready states on Windows.
